message.content:
Let's fetch the Wikipedia Moon page via `run_command` using `curl` with a custom User-Agent, so we don't get 403 Forbidden.
```python
res = await run_command('curl -s -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)" "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon" | grep -i -C 3 "perigee"')
print(res[:2000])
```
